achievements: Achieved 78% unit test coverage on core modules
sprints.summary: Sprint 1 completed at 85% of planned velocity (34/40 points). The team delivered the geospatial ingestion pipeline and Mapbox integration on schedule. A GDAL version conflict on CI caused a 2-day delay mid-sprint but was resolved without scope changes. Velocity is stable and the team is well-positioned for Sprint 2.

achievements: Drone trajectory calculation engine v1.0 shipped
REST API for flight path queries live on staging
sprints.summary: Sprint 2 was the strongest sprint to date — 41/42 points completed (98% velocity). No blockers materialised and the team shipped the trajectory engine ahead of schedule. Commit frequency increased 34% over Sprint 1, indicating the team has hit its stride. Sprint 3 carries elevated technical risk following a revert of the altitude calculation algorithm.

blockers.description: Memory leak in QGIS processing module causing test failures in CI — 4 PRs blocked
Altitude calculation revert (PR#42) still under review — blocks all trajectory feature work

achievements: QGIS plugin alpha released to internal testers
Memory profiling tooling integrated into CI pipeline
sprints.summary: Sprint 3 is trending significantly below target at the midpoint — 18/44 points (41%) with 6 days remaining. Two critical blockers are compounding: a memory leak in the QGIS module is blocking CI merges, and the altitude algorithm revert is halting all trajectory feature work. Immediate risk escalation to RSK-001 and RSK-002 is recommended. Velocity has decelerated sharply from Sprint 2's high of 98%.
